sources.note: Nothing on stress for any Tivoid language. Eman appears only in Table 1 (800 speakers, source ALCAM), the untoned 120-item ALCAM datasheet column 'Eman [=Amanavil]' in Table 8, and the Central Tivoid B subgrouping (sect. 6.1). Sect. 3.1: 'For Tivoid languages, phonologies of any sort exist for only five languages, Tiv, Iyive, Iceve, Esimbi and Ugarə.' Sect. 3.3 Tones covers only Tiv, Ugarə, Esimbi.
